name: MAC Unit (Yosys)
_about: Synthetic showcase project. The notes, commits and logs are written for the demo; the two synthesis reports are real Yosys 0.9 output of the synthetic designs in demo/yosys. mac_v3_hier_stat.rpt is deliberately left out so it can be imported live (review-before-commit).

events.text: Goal: 8-bit multiply-accumulate unit for the edge-inference tile. Must pass tb_mac (256 vectors) and stay under 520 generic cells in Yosys synth.
commit a1c09e2: mac_v1.v - single-cycle MAC (acc <= acc + a*b), synchronous reset, 16-bit accumulator.
tb_mac (Icarus) on mac_v1: 256/256 vectors PASS. 0 mismatches.
Decision: register the product before the adder (one pipeline stage) to shorten the multiply-add path. Costs one cycle of latency and some flip-flops.
commit 7be4410: mac_v2.v - product registered (prod_q), accumulator adds prod_q. One extra cycle of latency.
tb_mac (Icarus) on mac_v2: 250/256 vectors PASS, 6 FAIL. Mismatches all on the first accumulate after reset: expected values assume single-cycle latency.
Sam (chat): the v2 failures are fixed, all 256 vectors pass now.
Next: update tb_mac's expected values for the extra cycle of latency and re-run to confirm v2 really passes. Then try the hierarchical version (mac_v3_hier) and compare cell counts against v2.
